notes.payload.idempotencyKey: One per request the user makes in Atlas. Reuse it on every retry of that request.
notes.payload.atlasProjectId: The Atlas project. One open or promoted request per Atlas project.
notes.payload.atlasRevision: Atlas's revision of the project when the request was built.
notes.payload.requestedBy: The sha256 of the Atlas user id. Never an email or a name.
notes.payload.target.workspaceId: The workspace Atlas asks for. The reviewer picks the final one.
notes.payload.target.label: The project label Atlas proposes.
notes.payload.target.projectId: A suggested project id. The reviewer picks the final one.
notes.payload.progress: `{"done":n,"total":n}` with whole numbers from 0, or null.
notes.payload.cowork.requested: Whether Atlas asks for the Cowork setup hand-off.

features.rule: Scoped to the calling credential's integration: a flag is true only when the feature is shipped, its env gate is "true", and the integration may file `project-onboarding`. A payload field whose flag is false is refused with 400 FEATURE_OFF naming it, never stripped. Read features before each send.

integrationId.description: The integration the credential belongs to.

decisionNote.description: True only when this feature is built, `INBOUND_DECISION_NOTE_ENABLED` is on, and this credential's integration may file `project-onboarding`.

supersedes.description: True only when this feature is built, `INBOUND_SUPERSEDES_ENABLED` is on, and this credential's integration may file `project-onboarding`. While false, a payload carrying `supersedes` is refused with `FEATURE_OFF`.

appDiscovery.description: True only when this feature is built, `INBOUND_APP_DISCOVERY_ENABLED` is on, and this credential's integration may file `project-onboarding`.

requestedSubapps.description: True only when this feature is built, `INBOUND_REQUESTED_SUBAPPS_ENABLED` is on, and this credential's integration may file `project-onboarding`. While false, a payload carrying `requestedSubapps` is refused with `FEATURE_OFF`.

aiAgents.description: True only when this feature is built, `INBOUND_AI_AGENTS_ENABLED` is on, and this credential's integration may file `project-onboarding`. While false, a payload carrying `aiAgents` is refused with `FEATURE_OFF`.

features.description: The optional project-onboarding features this credential's integration may use. Read them before sending; a missing route or a 400 is never a capability signal.

bridgeMediaCrossOrigin.description: Whether this OS serves bridge-page media to this credential's origin. Always false in this version.

submissionId.description: Use it to read the submission back.

payloadSha256.description: sha256 of the stored submission document.

payloadBytes.description: Size of the stored submission document.

note.description: A reminder that nothing was applied.

submissionId.description: The id the first request with this idempotency key was given.

payloadSha256.description: sha256 of the stored submission document.

fieldNames.description: The payload's top-level keys, sorted. Never the values.

state.description: `filed`: no human has decided yet (a promotion in progress still reads `filed`). `promoted` and `rejected`: only for `project-onboarding`, whose decision the OS records. `promoted-or-withdrawn`: a human acted on a `state-update`; the server does not record which way.

outcome.description: `project-onboarding` only. On `rejected`, the reason code. On `promoted`, the project, unless `outcomeWithheld` says why not. Never the reviewer.

outcomeWithheld.description: Present on a `promoted` answer that carries no `outcome`. `scope`: the credential lacks `read:context`; re-mint it with both scopes. `workspace-not-shared`: the project's workspace is not on `inbound.api.readWorkspaces`.

workspaceId.description: The OS workspace the project was created in.

projectId.description: The project id the OS assigned. Store it; it is how the OS names the project.

setupState.description: How far the project's setup has got in the OS. `none` until a human starts it.

reasonCode.description: Why, from a fixed list. Never free text.

label.description: Its display label. Operator-typed free text.

enabled.description: False for a disabled one. Disabled items are listed, not hidden.

isDefault.description: True for the instance's default workspace, or the default project.

instanceId.description: A stable id for this OS instance, generated once into the setting `instance.id`. No route writes it.

workspaces.description: Default workspace first, then by label.

projects.description: Default project first, then by label.

projectId.description: The project whose enable state was read: the workspace's default project.

label.description: The sub-app's display name, as its manifest states it.

icon.description: The glyph the OS navigation shows for it (an emoji).

path.description: The console path that opens it, relative to the OS origin. Opening it still needs an OS sign-in and the OS's own role check.

visibleToRoles.description: The workspace roles the OS shows it to. This route cannot filter by user.

apps.description: The sub-apps enabled there, in manifest order.

code.description: A Fastify error code, for example `FST_ERR_CTP_BODY_TOO_LARGE`.

issues.description: Zod issues. They name paths and rules, never the submitted values.

error.const: a payload field was sent for a feature that is off for this credential

field.description: The first payload field whose feature is off.

fields.description: Every such field, in the order of `features`. Remove them, or wait until `features` says true.

issues.description: Where, and which rule: the path and a Zod code. Never a key you sent, never a value.

submissionId.description: The request that holds this Atlas project.

state.description: `filed`: still open. `promoted`: a project was created from it.
